tools.name: cdms_query
tools.description: Run a semantic or nominal search across the knowledge graph.

parameters.mode: Optional. One of: auto, semantic, nominal. Default is auto.

tools.name: cdms_node
tools.description: Retrieve the full anatomy, summary, concepts, and relationships for a specific node ID.

parameters.id: The UUID of the node to retrieve.

tools.name: cdms_history
tools.description: Retrieve the historical state of a node at a specific ISO-8601 timestamp.

tools.name: cdms_mutations
tools.description: Monitor recent mutations to identify what changed in the project recently.
